title: Wren and the Portrait
author: Mirabel Brightwater
blurb: Rafael Iversen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
